title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_mac_os_sierra_al_100_by_furio_piccinini_ddo37 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_mac_os_sierra_al_100_by_furio_piccinini_ddo37' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. This compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted machine. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by the package.
